characters.description: A returning outworlder adventurer who is protecting Sophie and Belinda while helping investigate the disaster that killed Farrah.
characters.name: Jason Asano

characters.description: A skilled Celestine fighter seeking a lasting escape from criminal coercion.
characters.name: Sophie Wexler

characters.description: Sophie's closest ally and companion in seeking a safer future.
characters.name: Belinda

characters.description: An astral-magic specialist in Jason's circle.
characters.name: Clive Standish

characters.description: A returning young adventurer from the Geller family and a member of Jason's circle.
characters.name: Humphrey Geller

characters.description: Jason's returning mentor and Farrah's grieving friend.
characters.name: Rufus Remore

characters.description: A Leonid ally of Jason and Rufus who mourns Farrah.
characters.name: Gary

characters.description: A deceased adventurer whose loss during the failed expedition drives Rufus and Gary to identify the force responsible.
characters.name: Farrah

characters.description: A Priestess of Purity known from earlier events whose return carries unresolved distrust.
characters.name: Anisa

characters.description: Greenstone's Magic Society director and a hostile institutional rival.
characters.name: Lucian Lamprey

characters.description: A dangerous figure from Sophie's past whose continuing interest threatens her freedom.
characters.name: Cole Silva

characters.description: An official who recommends that the Church of Purity examine five expedition survivors with altered auras after captured enemies used concealed devices to prevent their own capture.
characters.name: Amir Bahadir

characters.description: Cassandra's brother, returned from the expedition with an incompatible tracking aura and marked personality changes. He is one of five survivors sought for examination.
characters.name: Thadwick Mercer

characters.description: A senior Mercer family figure and Thadwick's mother. She tells Jason that she regrets the end of his relationship with Cassandra, but he rejects her apology.
characters.name: Thalia Mercer

characters.description: Thadwick's sister, a member of the Mercer family, and someone with an established personal connection to Jason.
characters.name: Cassandra Mercer

characters.description: An established Gold-rank patron and owner of the Cloud Palace.
characters.name: Emir

characters.description: Emir's portal specialist, able to relocate Sophie and Belinda if they choose to leave Greenstone.
characters.name: Hester

characters.description: The Silver-rank director of Greenstone's Adventure Society branch. Institutional scrutiny forces her to protect Sophie's service agreement despite her earlier opposition.
characters.name: Elspeth Arella

characters.description: Arella's politically connected father and adviser. He orders her to obey procedure during the inquiry while treating Jason as a problem to address later.
characters.name: Adris Dorgan

characters.description: A Silver-rank Geller adventurer who returns from the failed expedition and helps coordinate the response to its hidden enemy.
characters.name: Danielle Geller

characters.description: A Geller team adventurer returning from the failed expedition. He credits Jason's earlier mirage-chamber training with helping his team endure losses and evacuate survivors.
characters.name: Rick Geller

characters.description: A Knowledge acolyte who presents Jason with a divine bargain.
characters.name: Gabrielle Pellin

characters.description: The Archbishop of Purity who conducts a divine cleansing examination on an altered expedition survivor.
characters.name: Archbishop Hendren

characters.description: A Geller family fighter who agrees to practice unarmed combat with Sophie.
characters.name: Phoebe Geller

characters.description: Humphrey's shape-changing familiar, able to take bird form for scouting.
characters.name: Stash

characters.description: A healer Jason plans to invite into his proposed adventuring group.
characters.name: Neil Davone

characters.description: Clive's rune tortoise familiar. Onslow can merge with Clive as a runic tattoo, giving Clive access to the powers inscribed on the familiar's shell.
characters.name: Onslow

characters.description: An alchemist separated from his usual companions who witnesses the recording of Jason's confrontation with an altered survivor.
characters.name: Jory Tillman

characters.description: Leader of a rival Iron-rank team drawn into Jason's three-way mirage-chamber exercise. She uses plant and poison abilities while directing a coordinated withdrawal.
characters.name: Beth Cavendish

characters.description: Rufus's Gold-rank father, who arrives in Greenstone aboard a ship carrying adventurers recruited for Emir.
characters.name: Gabriel Remore

characters.description: Emir's operational lieutenant, responsible for organizing the Reaper contest and balancing his broader direction with practical coordination.
characters.name: Constance

characters.description: A shadow-being bound to administer the ruined Order of the Reaper's trials. It once served as the last Grand Master's familiar and explains the choices and dangers facing entrants.
characters.name: Trial Administrator

characters.description: A well-equipped foreign swordsman who recruits the separated Clive for his Builder expertise. He leads their temporary group while accepting that Clive's powers require careful cooperation.
characters.name: Valdis

characters.description: A capable frontline defender travelling with Neil and Jory in Fallen Echoes. He helps hold their temporary group together when hostile entrants and Vorgia threaten them.
characters.name: Imran Keen

characters.description: Jason's leech familiar, used to spread afflictions and support his accelerated healing.
characters.name: Colin

characters.description: A Celestine princess whom Jason meets after escaping a hostile adventuring party by entering her tent.
characters.name: Zara

characters.description: An associate of Cole Silva who offers to arrange for a Silver-rank adventurer to abduct Jason in exchange for access to selected victims.
characters.name: Killian Laurent

characters.description: The former trial administrator, now summoned as Jason's Iron-rank familiar. Shade can operate through several shadow bodies, conceal people, and transfer mana.
characters.name: Shade

characters.description: An Avatar of Doom summoned as Jason's familiar. Gordon attacks with paired force beams, can dash through enemies, and can hide within Jason's aura.
characters.name: Gordon

characters.description: Belinda's Astral Lantern familiar. Shimmer can expose hidden enemies, launch disruptive-force attacks, negate magical projectiles, and merge into Belinda's eyes.
characters.name: Shimmer

characters.description: Belinda's Echo Spirit familiar. Gemini can imitate other people, exchange places with copied allies, mirror movement, and alter the aura Belinda projects.
characters.name: Gemini
